recognize_zh: 扁桃腺鱗狀上皮內可見多個圓形、界線清楚的非典型淋巴細胞巢（類 Pautrier 微膿瘍），細胞巢周圍有收縮間隙；C 圖免疫染色使上皮內與上皮下的淋巴細胞巢瀰漫陽性，提示成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤具親上皮性。
features: Panel A: low-power tonsil with diffuse lymphoid infiltrate and circled surface squamous epithelium
Panel B: squamous epithelium containing multiple well-circumscribed, rounded intraepithelial nests of atypical lymphoid cells with peripheral retraction spaces
Lymphoid cells are small to medium with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei, and similar cells diffusely infiltrate the underlying tissue
Panel C: immunostain with strong diffuse positivity in the intraepithelial nests and subepithelial infiltrate (antibody not labeled)
describe_en: Composite tonsillar biopsy. At low power (A), the tonsil is diffusely infiltrated by lymphoid cells. The overlying squamous epithelium (B) contains multiple sharply circumscribed intraepithelial aggregates of atypical small to medium lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, forming Pautrier-like microabscesses, with a similar dense infiltrate beneath the epithelium. An immunostain (C) highlights the neoplastic cells within the nests and in the subepithelial infiltrate; the antibody is not specified. The epidermotropic-like pattern is consistent with a mature T-cell lymphoma, and in this context supports adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; HTLV-1 serology and CD4/CD25/FOXP3 immunophenotyping are recommended.

ddx.vs: True Pautrier microabscesses occur in skin with cerebriform cells and no HTLV-1 infection, rather than in tonsillar mucosa.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with lymphoepithelial lesions
ddx.vs: B cells (CD20+) infiltrate and destroy glands/crypt epithelium rather than forming discrete intraepithelial T-cell nests.
May be epitheliotropic but is HTLV-1 negative and usually lacks the CD25+/FOXP3+ regulatory T-cell phenotype of ATLL.
Reactive intraepithelial lymphocytes are scattered, mixed B and T cells, without cohesive atypical nests.
